programme.title: Mary Shelley
programme.desc: The torrid true-life tale of how a passionate love affair fueled the creation of trailblazing writer Mary Shelley's Gothic masterwork, Frankenstein. Elle Fanning stars.

programme.title: Spooks: The Greater Good
programme.desc: When a terrorist escapes custody during a routine handover, Will Holloway must team with disgraced MI5 Intelligence Chief Harry Pearce to track him down before an imminent terrorist attack on London.

programme.title: The Sicilian
programme.desc: From best-selling author Mario Puzo comes the riveting saga of the life, loves and dreams of the infamous Sicilian bandit Salvatore Giuliano.

programme.title: 21 & Over
programme.desc: The night before his medical school interview, a student celebrates his 21st birthday with two friends.

programme.title: Disaster Movie
programme.desc: DISASTER MOVIE lampoons the blockbuster movie, pop culture icons and public figures along the way.

programme.title: Superhero Movie
programme.desc: An orphaned teenager is bitten by a radioactive dragonfly, granting him superhuman powers.

programme.title: Movie 43
programme.desc: Film is a series of comedy sketches in the style of "Kentucky Fried Movie" and "The Groove Tube."

programme.title: G-Loc
programme.desc: In a world on the brink of environmental collapse, mass migration to neighbouring planet, Rhea, is humanity's final hope for survival. The only problem is, in the sixteen Earth years since the first humans landed on Rhea, two hundred and eighty-eight years have passed on the new planet and the existing population are no longer welcoming new arrivals, with the Rheans having set up a space blockade to shot down any ship that tries to cross into their territory. 'Earther', Bran, has big dreams of a better life in this new world, but the odds are stacked against him. Finding himself the lone survivor of a failed emigration attempt, his escape pod floats mindlessly in space and his oxygen is running low. His only chance of survival is to hook up to a rogue Rhean supply ship called The Nysa running on auxiliary power. But after finding the crew on board The Nysa dead, it seems Bran may have more than just a hostile planet to worry about. An intense interstellar thriller with an impressive cast, including Stephen Moyer (True Blood), Casper Van Dien (Starship Troopers) and John Rhys-Davies (the Indiana Jones and Lord of the Rings franchises).

programme.title: It's a Boy Girl Thing
programme.desc: It's A Boy Girl Thing is a brilliantly funny romantic comedy about next-door neighbours who live worlds apart. Woody Deane (Zegers) and Nell Bedworth (Armstrong) are life long sworn enemies who wake up one day to find themselves in a very strange place: each others bodies. In their switched identities, each sets out to destroy the other's high school reputation. When they start to succeed they get more than they bargained for. Sometimes falling in love can be an out of body experience.

programme.title: The Way
programme.desc: Martin Sheen plays Tom, an American doctor who comes to France to collect the remains of his adult son who was killed in the Pyrenees in a storm while walking The Camino de Santiago - also known as 'The Way of Saint James'. Driven by his desire to understand his lost son, Tom decides to embark on the historical pilgrimage, leaving his California life behind. Armed only with his son's backpack and guidebook, he begins the 800km historical pilgrimage but soon discovers that he won't be alone on this journey - he meets other pilgrims from around the world, all broken and looking for greater meaning in their lives. From the hardship experienced along "The Way" an unlikely group of misfits are bonded and Tom begins to learn the difference between 'The life we live and the life we choose.'

programme.title: Lady Bloodfight
programme.desc: Jane is a beautiful but troubled American girl backpacking her way through Hong Kong. When she successfully fends off three thugs trying to rob her, it draws the attention of Shu, a Wudang champion, who is impressed by her raw street fighting abilities. Shu recruits Jane and trains her to fight in the vicious, all-female, underground martial arts tournament known as The Kumite.

programme.title: Witch Hunt
programme.desc: Hunted. Persecuted. Executed. The witch trials come to life in modern day America. Claire (Gideon Adlon - The Craft: Legacy) and her mother (Elizabeth Mitchell - The Expanse) are part of an underground movement that ferries women accused of witchcraft to safety. All is well until a new charge brings the witch hunters to their door. Will they also be charged with the ungodly crime of being a witch?

programme.title: The Beast
programme.desc: After the mutilated body of a missing girl is discovered in the tidelands of Incheon, rivals Han-su and Min-tae, are in charge of finding the culprit. Things take a dark turn when Han-su meets an informant who insists he knows who the murderer is. As cover-ups and secret deals ensue, tensions rise between the two detectives as the pressure of solving the crime is shaking up the Korean peninsula.

programme.title: Summer of '72
programme.desc: A beautiful yet relevant romance about love and diversity in an allegory of America today, starring Stranger Things Natalia Dyer. 1972. Tuscaloosa, Alabama. Amid war protests and racial tensions, Billy works at the asylum run by his psychiatrist father. As he falls for Virginia, a patient, his best friend becomes involved with a radical civil rights activist against Tuscaloosa's power elite.

programme.title: Bar Fight!
programme.desc: Time to settle the score, one drink at a time. Theres only one way to assert dominance after a break up and for Nina (Melissa Fumero, Brooklyn Nine-Nine) and Allen (Luka Jones, Up All Night) its a turf war for their local watering hole. Lines have been drawn and with the help of Ninas best friend Chelsea (Rachel Bloom, Crazy Ex-Girlfriend) its going to be a winner takes all affair.

programme.title: Hamlet
programme.desc: Ian McKellen stars in the classic tale of revenge that has stood the test of time, reimagined for the modern day as a psychological thriller.

programme.title: Five Nights in Maine
programme.desc: A man, reeling from the tragic loss of his wife, travels to rural Maine to seek answers from his estranged mother-in-law, who is herself confronting grief. With David Oyelowo and Dianne Wiest.

programme.title: The Man Without a Face
programme.desc: A drama film about a young boy who befriends a disfigured recluse in a small coastal town and helps him overcome his fear of society and confront his past.

programme.title: Life at These Speeds
programme.desc: After a teenager's friends are killed in an accident, he finds running allows him to remember them perfectly. Running, however, also brings him notoriety. Soon he finds himself caught between keeping the past alive and making new memories in the present.

programme.title: The Christmas Setup
programme.desc: (2020) Festive rom com with Hugo Spencer and Blake Lee. Back home for Christmas, big city lawyer Hugo is set up by his matchmaker mum with his high school crush Patrick. Is the magic still there?

programme.title: Christmas By Design
programme.desc: (2023) Festive rom com with Rebecca Dalton. Reluctantly in her hometown for Christmas, can NYC fashion designer Charlotte discover what's really important in life with the help of a charming local?

programme.title: Christmas by The Book
programme.desc: A bestselling writer is dispatched by a TV talk show to a rural town where she is given two weeks to re-create the magical childhood Christmas described in her book. Starring Lindy Booth (2022)

programme.title: A Christmas To Cherish
programme.desc: (2019) Heartwarming holiday drama with Peter Porte. A couple preparing to celebrate the perfect Christmas together must swap the fireside eggnog for a fight to save the beloved local community centre.

programme.title: A Kiss For Christmas
programme.desc: (2011) Festive romance with Elisabeth Röhm. Filled with Christmas spirit, a woman shares a spontaneous kiss with a handsome stranger in a lift, only to discover he's her demanding manager's boyfriend.

programme.title: The World We Make
programme.desc: 18 year old Lee (a spirited equestrian) and Jordan (an academic and football standout) are at the threshold of building a life together. But their character is tested when racial bias surfaces in their otherwise progressive small town.

programme.title: Love In Wolf Creek
programme.desc: On the verge of losing her wildlife refuge, Sam, along with the town's handsome newcomer, Austin, risk it all to save an injured white wolf.

programme.title: Tell Me I Love You
programme.desc: Three musicians pull off a scam to pay for their first album. However their past affairs, sexuality, and concept of "family" disrupt societal conventions. With a hit album on the way and stardom right at their fingertips, they must decide what true love is, and what they each mean to each other.

programme.title: Tell It to the Bees
programme.desc: When mill worker Lydia is abandoned by her philandering husband, she struggles to look after herself and her son Charlie. Local doctor Jean is one of the few to help and a friendship develops that blossoms into a romance that will scandalise the town.

programme.title: The Immigrant
programme.desc: Marion Cotillard, Joaquin Phoenix, and Jeremy Renner star in the story of Ewa, a recent immigrant to America who falls prey to a charming but wicked man who forces her into prostitution.

programme.title: Sound Of Christmas
programme.desc: Whilst trying to reignite his daughter's passion for Christmas, Brad, falls in love with piano teacher, Lizzie. However, their romance is threatened by Brad's business interests.

programme.title: Dognapped: Hound for the Holidays
programme.desc: An assistant of an influencer and a charming vet bond to find a missy puppy before Christmas.

programme.title: A Christmas Princess
programme.desc: A prince from Europe comes to New York for a royal holiday dinner and falls in love with the chef that is planning the event.

programme.title: Fixing Up Christmas
programme.desc: Known as a “fixer” for difficult clients, a talented party planner must help a young CEO plan the Christmas party of the year to dazzle the mayor and save his company. Wil the "fixer" fix something more than just the company?

programme.title: Christmas in Mississippi
programme.desc: Photographer Holly returns to Gulfport, Mississippi for Christmas. Their traditional holiday light show has been revived again since a hurricane struck five years earlier. She is shocked to learn the festival is run by her high school sweetheart, Mike.

programme.title: Starting Up Love
programme.desc: A young finance executive inherits her uncle's mountain cabin only to discover that he also left half of it to the ruggedly handsome handyman that had been caring for it.

programme.title: Plus One at an Amish Wedding
programme.desc: April Monroe is a superstar doctor at a big New York hospital, who has fallen head-over-heels for charming veterinarian Jesse, and their relationship seems to be heading in the right direction except for one thing: Jesse is completely tight-lipped about his Amish family.

programme.title: Made For You with Love
programme.desc: The owner of used wedding gown business breathes new life into used dresses, making dreams come true for brides unable to afford pricey gowns. But when she meets the perfect guy, she's afraid to give her own heart a second chance at love.

programme.title: Beauty And the Billionaire- Series
programme.desc: Mason's product launch is failing, leading him to make life difficult for Jess. Stan wants to discuss Mason's business missteps at a dinner with a few trusted friends. Jess is invited along and witnesses first-hand the drama Mason faces in his own family.

programme.title: Beauty And the Billionaire- Series
programme.desc: Mason and Jess take a business trip to Switzerland in attempts for it to be safer than home for Mason. The walls between them start to come down, and with it understanding. But their moment of peace is disturbed when a new threat appears.

programme.title: Prescription For Love
programme.desc: Claire, a nurse, fights for a chance at love with a charming new doctor and for a promotion to free herself from the misery her supervisor creates. As her supervisor tries to derail Claire's chance at happiness, Claire will have to stand up for herself and go after her dreams.

programme.title: The Pregnancy Pact
programme.desc: Blogger Sidney Bloom investigates teen pregnancies in her hometown high school.

programme.title: The Perfect Teacher
programme.desc: High-schooler Devon Cory (Megan Park) targets teacher Jim Wilkes.

programme.title: Too Young to Die?
programme.desc: True story of a 15-year-old girl facing adult trial for murder.

programme.title: Kelly / Rose / Lt. Prescott and Gwen
programme.desc: A mother of three survives a prolonged attack from her estranged husband.

programme.title: The Pregnancy Pact
programme.desc: Blogger Sidney Bloom investigates teen pregnancies in her hometown high school.

programme.title: A Friend's Obsession
programme.desc: After Megan's fiancé is killed, Lloyd follows her to win her love, but her new boyfriend stands in the way.

programme.title: Eyewitness
programme.desc: It has been five years after Diana send a man to jail for the murder of her father and fiancee. Then he escapes from prison. He keeps her captive in her own home. Did Diana put an innocent man away?

programme.title: Game of Love
programme.desc: Ex-Wife Frances conspires with her grown children to force Jake to sell his cherished Seattle basketball team. Will game changing moves off the court help reignite romantic sparks?

programme.title: A Man for Every Month
programme.desc: Blogger, Megan, tends to shy away from dating, but that all changes when her boss assigns her to vlog her dates for the eligible bachelor calendar. Now pushed out of her comfort zone, Megan must quickly learn the golden rules of dating.

programme.title: Love Club: Tara, The
programme.desc: Tara, a free spirit who doesn't need love, asks the Love Club to help plan Tara's commitment-to-herself party.

programme.title: The Internship
programme.desc: Billy (Vince Vaughn) and Nick (Owen Wilson) are salesmen whose careers have been torpedoed by the digital world. Trying to prove they are not obsolete, they defy the odds by talking their way into a coveted internship at Google, along with a battalion of brilliant college students.

programme.title: As of Yet
programme.desc: Told entirely through video calls and digital diaries, Naomi navigates a problematic roommate and a burgeoning romance all while locked down during the Coronavirus pandemic.

programme.title: Joe Somebody
programme.desc: Tim Allen is Joe, a guy whose life has been steadily changing for the worse. When the office bully goes too far, Joe decides it's time to turn himself from a nobody into a somebody.

programme.title: Plunder Quest
programme.desc: After catching wind of valuable prohibition-era whiskey hidden on an island, Thomas Waters embarks on a quest for liquid gold and ends up on the priceless adventure of a lifetime.

programme.title: Above The Clouds
programme.desc: When Charlie discovers her parents have hidden her real father from her, she does what any 18-year old would - recruits a homeless guy as her 'responsible adult' and sets off to Scotland on her provisional driving licence to go find him.

programme.title: Bandidos
programme.desc: Renowned gunman Richard Martin is traveling on a train, held up by Billy Kane, a former student of Martin's. Kane spares Martin, but only after shooting his hands. Years later, Martin meets an escaped convict, wrongly convicted for the train robbery. Martin trains his new student and both men seek out Billy Kane.

programme.title: Colt in the Hand of the Devil
programme.desc: Scotty is hired to eliminate a gang of Mexican bandits led by El Condor. He cleverly earns their trust to trap them—but as he bonds with El Condor, a true friendship and mutual respect begin to challenge his mission.

programme.title: Singing Guns
programme.desc: Notorious stagecoach robber Rhiannon is unintentionally appointed as deputy when he saves the sheriff's life and must wear two hats between his new job that he enjoys and his old occupation that he misses.

programme.title: Incredible Rocky Mountain Race
programme.desc: An old man observes a boy bullying his playmates and treats him to a morality lesson. The man tells the story of the epic cross-country race between a young Mark Twain and his rival, Mike Fink.

programme.title: Four Gunmen of the Holy Trinity
programme.desc: Arms trafficking with the Indians on the one hand and acquiring documents concerning the ownership of a goldmine on the other are the principal interests of Quin and Gomez, the highly suspicious guests at Papa Martinez' inn.

programme.title: Hamlet
programme.desc: Multi award-winning film of the classic Shakespeare a play within a play'.

programme.title: Heads We Go
programme.desc: A beautiful model spends all her money in order to follow a young man who has intrigued her to Deauville.

programme.title: Go to Blazes
programme.desc: When bank clerk David Preston returns home at seven, his wife tells him that he did not come home at seven, or at any other time, the previous evening. To his amazement, he has no idea where he could have been. There is a complete gap in his memory between the time he left the bank on Monday until his arrival home that following evening. The family doctor is inclined at first to treat it lightly, but during Preston's 24-hour loss of memory, a murder has been committed.

programme.title: Nowhere To Go
programme.desc: In London, a Canadian serving prison time for grand theft escapes prison and attempts to retrieve his loot.

programme.title: The Spider And The Fly
programme.desc: Just before the First World War, a safe-cracking thief is baffling the Paris police.

programme.title: The Reel Thing
programme.desc: Working as consultants for an archeology adventure film, Sydney and Nigel realize the Pharaoh Amun II's props are genuine, long-thought lost relics. How can they be?

programme.title: Out of the Past
programme.desc: Claudia discovers that she was Cleopatra's servant in a past life when she experiences déjà vu while watching a catalog from an Ancient Egyptian relics exposition.

programme.title: Eyes of Toklamanee
programme.desc: Sydney and her student Adam are onto his ancestors' fabled Eyes of Toklamanee, but they are pursued by mysterious gunmen.

programme.title: Run Sydney Run
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel are ambushed in Russia. Two weeks later, Sydney wakes up in the house of a man called Tsarlov, who claims to have saved her.

programme.title: M.I.A.
programme.desc: Sydney gets kidnapped, but by whom? Nigel, Claudia and Cate will have to go through the list of enemies Sydney has made in the past and deduce which of them is responsible. Cue flashbacks.

programme.title: Dont Go Into the Woods
programme.desc: Sydney's friend phones to inform her that he's discovered information on the Golden Hawk of Maribor, lost since 1711. Sydney and Nigel travel to Lubjanka to meet him, but he's already gone.

programme.title: French Connection
programme.desc: While on a lecture tour with Nigel in Europe, Sydney is contacted by MI5 because she is the only one who can prevent an impending high-level assassination.

programme.title: Midnight Flight
programme.desc: Germania, ca. 400 AD: an artifact called Gunther's Scepter is sealed in a vault. Kleine Burgh, 2001: Sydney and Nigel are hired to find it using a crystal and a stone tablet.

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: The Middle Ages may never be the same after street smart Jamal Walker falls into a moat at the Medieval World theme park and finds himself transported back in time.

programme.title: Elektra
programme.desc: From the pages of Marvel Comics — creators of X-Men and Spider-Man — comes ELEKTRA, the first action-event movie of the year. In the ultimate battle between good and evil stands a warrior who makes the choice that tips the balance.

programme.title: Miracles: The Canton Godfather
programme.desc: A country boy becomes the head of a gang through the purchase of some lucky roses from an old lady. He and a singer at the gang's nightclub try to do a good deed for the old lady when her daughter comes to visit.

programme.title: Beyond the Law
programme.desc: A former mobster turned businessman and a police detective must contend with a dirty ex-cop looking to bring the killer of his son to justice.

programme.title: After Earth
programme.desc: Far in the future, a young boy and his estranged father navigates an abandoned planet on which their space ship crashed.

programme.title: The Forgotten (2004)
programme.desc: Haunted by the memories of a son her husband swears she never had, a distraught mother's search for the truth leads to a mind-shattering conspiracy of unearthly terror.

programme.title: The Rundown (2003)
programme.desc: A bounty hunter travels to the Amazon to retrieve the son of a mob boss.

programme.title: Black Dawn (2005)
programme.desc: CIA Agent, Jonathan Cold is working undercover to determine who are the arms dealers, who want to sell a nuclear bomb to an Eastern European terrorist group. His cover gets detected when the weapons dealers catch his former student, beautiful Amanda Hayes. Cold fights to get her out. Together they go after the bomb and find out that Hayes' boss is involved in the bombing. At the end they vanquish all there enemies and have to drop off the activated bomb over the ocean.

programme.title: The Family Holiday
programme.desc: A thirty-something pool hustler stands to receive a ten-million dollar inheritance if he can prove he's forsaken his street days and settled down with a family.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Employee of the Month
programme.desc: The perpetually unlucky David Walsh (Matt Dillon) thinks he finally has it made after landing his dream job at a bank and getting engaged to Sara (Christina Applegate), a seemingly perfect woman. But in a single day, he's let go at work and his fiancée breaks up with him. Livid, David decides to come back to the bank armed and confront his boss, but, as he does so, a heist takes place. programme.title: Seun Kuti
programme.desc: Seun Anikulapo Kuti possesses the grace, energy and fury of his father, the legendary artist Fela Kuti. With the musicians of Fela Kuti's legendary band Egypt 80, Seaun Kuti brings the most original incarnation of Afrobeat to life. Digging deep into different African traditions, Seun has brought his own touch to the music by reflecting the difficulties and cultures of the continent. Three-quarters of Egypt 80's current line-up is composed of musicians who didn't only play with Fela Kuti, but often were arrested and harassed alongside the founder of the Afrobeat.

programme.title: Kurt Rosenwinkel, Tim Motzer & Gintas Janusonis
programme.desc: Jazzfest Bonn is an annual festival of modern and creative jazz music. Every May it presents local and international jazz musicians in concert halls all over the German city. Among the artists of the 2017 edition is Bandit 65, a trio of breathtaking virtuosity, great power, boundless breadth, and astounding beauty. Together with Tim Motzer on guitar and electronics, and Gintas Janusonis on drums and percussion, guitarist and band leader Kurt Rosenwinkel explores the intersection of guitars, rhythm, electronics, soundscapes, free improvisation, and telepathic interplay.

programme.title: Stochelo Rosenberg & Peter Beets
programme.desc: The treasured compositions of guitarist Django Reinhardt, the founding father of hot club jazz, are engraved in everyone's memory. Although Reinhardt missed two fingers of his left hand, his virtuoso technique was unrivalled. Dutch guitarist Stochelo Rosenberg and pianist Peter Beets now have the pleasure to bring Django's music back to life with their infectious improvisations.

programme.title: Art Blakey
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: James Brown
programme.sub-title: James Brown - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Back in 1981, legendary American singer James Brown gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. The "Godfather of Soul", "Mr. Dynamite", and "Soul Brother No. 1" was a major force in 20th century popular music, influencing many musicians in numerous genres.

programme.title: Elena Bashkirova, Juliane Banse, Emmanuel Pahud & Claudio Bohorquez
programme.desc: The extraordinarily talented pianist Elena Bashkirova has been president of the Felix Mendelssohn-Bartholdy Foundation in Leipzig since October 2020, succeeding legendary conductor Kurt Masur. In this concert at the Mendelssohn House in Leipzig, Bashkirova is joined by soprano Juliane Banse, flutist Emmanuel Pahud, cellist Claudio Bohórquez, clarinettist Karl-Heinz Steffens, and pianist Ohad Ben-Ari in a chamber music program dedicated to the music of Mendelssohn and his sister Fanny Hensel. The program opens with Mendelssohn's Piano Trio in D minor, Op. 49. This is followed by a selection of songs: Mendelssohn's Schilflied ‘Auf dem Teich, dem regungslosen', Op. 71 No. 4, and Reiselied ‘Der Herbstwind rüttelt die Bäume', Op. 34 No. 6 Hensel's Vorwurf, Op. 10 No. 2 Verlust, Op. 9 No. 10 and Sehnsucht, Op. 9 No. 7 Mendelssohn's ‘Allnächtlich im Traume seh ich dich', Op. 86 No. 4 ‘Die Liebende schreibt', Op. 86 No. 3 and Nachtlied ‘Vergangen ist der lichte Tag', Op. 71 No. 6. The program continues with Mendelssohn's Seven Songs without Words, for piano four-hands (Op. 62 Nos. 1-6, and Op. 67 No. 1), and comes to a close with Mendelssohn's Three pieces for clarinet, violoncello and piano (arr. Ernst Naumann), comprising Prelude, Op. 35 No. 4, Songs without Words, Op. 53 No. 2, and Duet, Op. 38 No. 6. This performance was recorded in November 2020.

programme.title: Philippe Jordan, Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris, Choeur de l'Opéra national de Paris & Ricarda Merbeth
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, maestro Jordan presents Beethoven's final symphony: Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. He conducts the Orchestre and Choeurs de l'Opéra national de Paris and four vocal soloists Ricarda Merbeth (soprano), Daniela Sindram (mezzosoprano), Robert Dean Smith (tenor), and Günther Groissböck (bass). Beethoven composed his last Symphony when his hearing had all but gone, between 1822 and 1824. Symphony No. 9 is the longest and most ambitious of Beethoven's symphonies. Most striking is the piece's finale movement, which includes a choir and four vocal soloists singing a setting of Friedrich Schiller's poem ‘An die Freude' (Ode to Joy). This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Renaud Capuçon, Gerard Causse, Iddo Bar-Shai & Jean-Jacques Kantorow
programme.sub-title: Chamber music by Mozart and Shostakovich
programme.desc: French violinist Renaud Capuçon appears at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, presenting a chamber music program consisting of classical and 20th century repertoire. He performs with the soloists of the International Menuhin Music Academy led by French conductor Jean-Jacques Kantorow. First on the program is Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Sinfonia Concertante in E-flat major, K. 364, in which Capuçon and violist Gérard Caussé appear as the soloists. Capuçon is then joined by pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï for a performance of Mozart's Sonata for violin and piano in E minor, K. 304. The program closes with Dmitri Shostakovich's Chamber Symphony in C minor, Op. 110a, which is a transcription of Shostakovich's String Quartet No. 8 by Russian conductor Rudolf Barshai, the composer's close friend. This performance was recorded at Château de Chantilly, on May 15, 2021.

programme.title: Kazuki Yamada & Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse
programme.desc: 2024 marks the 100th anniversary of Gabriel Fauré's death. He is considered one of the most important and influential composers, having been the teacher of Maurice Ravel, Georges Enescu, Nadia Boulanger and many others. The Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse and The Philharmonic Chorus of Tokyo, with Florian Sempey as soloist, perform Gabriel Fauré's Requiem in the Basilique de Saint-Sernin in Toulouse, the largest surviving Romanesque church in France and one of the most important buildings in Romanesque architecture. This extraordinary concert is conducted by Kazuki Yamada, who is currently one of the most exciting young maestros. In spring 2023, he was appointed Principal Conductor and Artistic Advisor of the City of Birmingham Symphony Orchestra, and is also Artistic and Musical Director of the Orchestre Philharmonique de Monte-Carlo.

programme.title: Sinne Eeg, Kristoffer Appel & Isabel Schwartzbach
programme.desc: The DR Symphony Orchestra breaks the sound barrier and takes you out into the galaxies — to a place between reality and fantasy with soundtracks from Star Wars, The Mandalorian, Star Trek, Dune, and many more. Join the orchestra on the third and final symphonic journey through musical universes and cinematic galaxies — all the way to the outermost asteroids and back to Earth again.

programme.title: R.E.M.
programme.desc: Filmed at Arena Civica, Milan, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic R.E.M. featuring unforgettable version of their hits: 'Losing My Religion', 'Drive', 'Man On the Moon' and many more.

programme.title: The Who
programme.sub-title: Live At The Isle Of Wight Festival 2004
programme.desc: In 2004 The Who returned to the Isle Of Wight Festival for the first time since their legendary performance in 1970. After a long absence, the festival had been reborn in 2002 and continues to this day. Their UK concerts in 2004 were the first in their home country since the death of founder member John Entwistle. As the evening shadows lengthened across the festival site, The Who took to the stage and delivered an incendiary performance packed with hit singles and classic album tracks and the concert more than lived up to the fan's expectations and memories of 1970.

programme.title: Peter Gabriel
programme.desc: Filmed in Modena, Italy across two nights in November 1993 as part of Peter Gabriel's acclaimed "Secret World Live" tour in support of the "Us" album, the show is elaborately presented and choreographed with two stages joined by a narrow pier. Peter Gabriel has always been a charismatic live performer with the ability to draw his audience into the onstage world he has created and rarely has this been better captured than on "Secret World Live". Peter Gabriel's Grammy Award winning film "Secret World Live" has now been newly restored and remastered from the original film to be seen and heard in the best possible quality.

programme.title: The Doobie Brothers
programme.desc: Filmed in high definition on 25 July 2004 at Wolf Trap National Park for the Performing Arts in Virginia, "Live At Wolf Trap" captures The Doobie Brothers in fine form on a set that mixes classic hits with some rarely performed tracks from across their extensive catalogue. This would prove to be the last recorded footage of long time drummer Keith Knudsen performing with the Doobie Brothers prior to his sad death from cancer in February 2005.

Una enfermera, Alma, se encarga de cuidarla en una solitaria casita junto al mar. El silencio de Elisabet contrasta con las confesiones íntimas de Alma. Entre las dos mujeres se establece una relación singular, inexplicable.

programme.desc: Jake Gyllenhaal protagoniza este thriller de acción sobre un hombre que despierta en el cuerpo de otro hombre para descubrir que solo él tiene la capacidad de detener un ataque terrorista en un tren de cercanías.

programme.title: Conversaciones con otras mujeres
programme.desc: Un hombre y una mujer próximos a los cuarenta se conocen en una boda en un hotel neoyorkino. Entablarán una conversación llena de ingenio y dobles sentidos en la que cada uno va cercando al otro con la precisión de un felino.

programme.title: Aprendiz de gigoló
programme.desc: Dos amigos judíos de edad avanzada (Allen y Turturro) se encuentran ante una desesperada situación financiera. Deciden entonces probar suerte con el negocio de la prostitución masculina, uno como gigoló y el otro como "representante". Pero el asunto no será bien visto en la comunidad judía en la que viven.

programme.title: Escobar: Paraíso perdido
programme.desc: El joven surfista Nick (Josh Hutcherson) se enamora perdidamente de una hermosa chica. Todo parece perfecto hasta que conoce al tío de ella, el famoso capo de la droga Pablo Escobar (Benicio Del Toro).

programme.title: Presa

programme.title: Azul y no tan rosa
programme.desc: Diego es un joven fotógrafo exitoso que vive en el glamoroso mundo de la moda, la superficialidad y el exceso. Un brutal ataque homófobo trastoca su vida cuando su pareja queda en coma. Justo en ese terrible momento, Diego, inesperadamente, debe cuidar de su hijo Armando...

programme.title: El Benefactor
programme.desc: La historia de un nostálgico filántropo (Richard Gere) que se involucra y se hace hueco en la vida de un matrimonio recién casado, Olivia (Dakota Fanning) y Luke (Theo James), buscando con ello recuperar experiencias vitales que antaño tuvo.

programme.title: Espacio/Tiempo
programme.desc: En un futuro al borde del colapso, unos científicos desarrollan una turbina para realizar viajes interestelares que podría salvar a la humanidad. Cuando les cortan la financiación por un fatal accidente, deciden recurrir a actividades delictivas para reconstruir su máquina.

programme.title: Petite Maman
programme.desc: Nelly tiene 8 años y acaba de perder a su abuela. Mientras ayuda a sus padres a vaciar la casa en la que su madre creció, explora el bosque que la rodea. Allí conoce a otra niña de su edad y surge una preciosa amistad. Entre juegos y confidencias, desvelarán un fascinante secreto.

programme.title: Cegados por el sol
programme.desc: Luca Guadagnino, el aclamado director de "Yo soy el amor", vuelve con una intenso thriller sexual protagonizado por Ralph Fiennes, Dakota Johnson, Matthias Schonaerts y Tilda Swinton.

programme.title: Bravetown
programme.desc: Josh es un alma sin rumbo con un talento musical extraordinario que se embarca en un viaje para encontrar lo que menos esperaba, pero que, sin duda alguna, más necesitaba.

programme.title: Negación
programme.desc: Drama judicial basado en el libro 'History On Trial'. La película cuenta el juicio entre la autora del libro, Deborah E. Lipstadt, y David Irving, famoso periodista admirador de Hitler al que ella había acusado de negar el holocausto, motivo por el que él se querelló contra ella por difamaciones.

programme.title: Una historia real
programme.desc: Cuando el desafortunado reportero del NY Times, Michael Finkel (Jonah Hill) conoce a Christian Longo (James Franco) –el cual ha robado su identidad– su investigación se convierte en una tensa persecución entre ratón y gato.

programme.title: El puente de San Luis Rey
programme.desc: En el Perú de 1714, un fraile es juzgado por la Inquisición por cuestionar las intenciones de Dios cuando cinco personas mueren en el derrumbe de un puente de cuerdas andino.

programme.title: Me Quiere, No Me Quiere
programme.desc: Un mujeriego vuelve a casa por vacaciones y se enreda con la mujer que le rompió el corazón años atrás.

programme.title: Amor a Primera Visa
programme.desc: Tras su fiesta de despedida, despierta en el apartamento de un apuesto mariachi y padre soltero.

programme.title: Lejos de la tierra quemada
programme.desc: Ópera prima de Guillermo Arriaga como director. Cuatro intensas historias en torno al amor.

programme.title: El Puente de San Luis Rey
programme.desc: Cuando el puente de San Luis se derrumba, los viajeros caen al abismo.

programme.title: Alex y Eva
programme.desc: Alex es un atractivo maestro de escuela de unos treinta años cuyos padres quieren que se case con una buena chica griega.

programme.title: Lecciones de amor
programme.desc: Comedia dramática sobre dos profesores: él de inglés (Clive Owen) y ella de arte (Juliette Binoche), que sostienen dos puntos de vista diametralmente opuestos se enfrentan en una especie de batalla para dirimir si son más importantes las palabras o las imágenes y la chispa entre ellos se enciende..

programme.title: Phillip Morris ¡Te quiero!
programme.desc: La improbable pero cierta historia de Steven Russell, un vendedor de una pequeña localidad de Estados Unidos que acaba en la cárcel. Allí conoce a un presidiario, Phillip Morris, del que se enamorará perdidamente.

programme.title: Novia Por Conveniencia
programme.desc: Una novia rusa que quiere conseguir el permiso de residencia es encargada porcorreo. Ella intenta compaginar su vida amorosa con su marido rico pero en bancarrota y su amante desaliñada pero encantadora.

programme.title: La historia de Marie Heurtin
programme.desc: Basada en una emocionante e inspiradora historia real. Marie Heurtin, de catorce años de edad, es sorda y ciega de nacimiento y es incapaz de comunicarse. Sus padres acuden al Instituto Larnay, especializado en la educación de niñas sordas. A pesar del escepticismo general, la hermana Marguerite acoge a esta "pequeña salvaje" bajo su protección, haciendo todo lo posible para educarla y sacarla de la oscuridad.

programme.title: El último vuelo
programme.desc: Sáhara francés, 1933. Bill Lancaster, un conocido piloto inglés, desaparece en el desierto en un intento récord de travesía. Su amante, la intrépida aviadora Marie Vallières de Beaumont se propone dar con él, cueste lo que cueste. El capitán del ejército francés Vincent Brosseau le da cobijo pero se niega ayudarle. Por miedo a los rebeldes tuaregs, Argel no autoriza ninguna operación de socorro. En un desierto donde no valen las mentiras, Marie y Vincent descubren una verdad insospechada.

programme.title: Tres solteros y un biberón
programme.desc: Tres hombres solteros comparten un piso en París. Su vida feliz y tranquila se trastoca con la llegada de un paquete un tanto peculiar: un bebé. Parece que la criatura no es hija de ninguno de los tres y no saben quién es el padre. Mientras buscan a su madre deciden cuidar a la pequeña sin tener ni idea de cómo se cría a un bebé.

programme.title: Vivarium
programme.desc: Una joven pareja se plantea la compra de su primer hogar. Para ello visitan una inmobiliaria donde los recibe un extraño agente de ventas, que les acompaña a una nueva, misteriosa y peculiar urbanización para mostrarles una vivienda unifamiliar.

programme.title: Four lions
programme.desc: Cuatro musulmanes que viven en Gran Bretaña toman la decisión de convertirse en terroristas. Omar y Waj viajan a Pakistán para asistir a un campo de adiestramiento para kamikazes, mientras que Barry y Fessal se dedican a adiestrar cuervos para que transporten bombas a través de las ventanas de los edificios. A los cuatro, se une un quinto terrorista, que sin embargo termina matándose accidentalmente durante un ejercicio.

programme.title: Los tigres del tren
programme.desc: Un ferroviario en la China de 1941 lucha contra los japoneses para lograr comida para los pobres.

programme.title: Nowhere
programme.desc: En un país latinoamericano, su dictador ha urdido un siniestro plan.

programme.title: Operación Concha
programme.desc: Un estafador atrae a un inversor contratando a un doble de una estrella de cine.

programme.title: Rivales
programme.desc: Dos equipos juveniles van a la final en Sevilla mientras se entrelazan historias familiares y sociales.

programme.title: Hojas de Hierba
programme.desc: Las vidas de dos gemelos idénticos (interpretados por Edward Norton) dan un giro cuando el primero, un profesor de filosofía, es confundido por el segundo, un traficante de drogas al que varios clanes del narcotráfico quieren ver muerto.

programme.title: St. Vincent
programme.desc: Con 2 nominaciones a los Globos de Oro y con un trío cómico protagonista impecable, 'St. Vincent' cuenta la historia de un chico cuyos padres se acaban de divorciar. La situación no es sencilla para él, le cuesta aceptar la nueva realidad. Sin embargo, las cosas cambian cuando conoce a su vecino.

programme.title: Un hombre llamado Ove
programme.desc: Ove no es el típico vecino con el que apetece cruzarte en el barrio. Es un cascarrabias, un pesado que insiste hasta la exageración en mantener el orden y la disciplina, un casi sesentón solitario y resentido a quien el destino ha arrebatado demasiadas cosas.

programme.title: Una piraña en el bidé
programme.desc: Julia quiere que sus padres separados, vuelvan a juntarse. Para ello consigue que su padre y su niñera África, que viven juntos, se peleen, y que África conquiste a Alejo, el compañero de su madre. Pero su madre se ha enamorado de Jorge, con el que espera un hijo.

programme.title: ¿Qué Pasó Anoche?
programme.desc: Dos parejas que se conocen una noche en un bar y se sienten atraídas mutuamente. El juego de seducción comienza, pero en el largo camino entre el local y el dormitorio, la realidad se va abriendo paso.

programme.title: The Animal (2001)
programme.desc: Puede que no parezca mucho, pero lo que cuenta está dentro. El genio de la comedia Rob Schneider (Deuce Bigalow: Male Gigolo, Big Daddy), Colleen Haskell del concurso de televisión Survivor, John C. McGinley (Any Given Sunday, The Rock) y Edward Asner (The Bachelor, JFK) aparecen en la comedia más escandalosa e histérica del año. Cuando el guardia de seguridad Marvin Mange (Schneider) responde a una llamada de emergencia sobre un robo en progreso, su sueño de convertirse en policía podría convertirse en realidad. Pero un extraño accidente de tráfico en su camino al lugar del crimen deja a Martin y a su sueño destrozados. Cuando Marvin se despierta una semana después, descubre que un científico desquiciado secretamente ha usado órganos de animales para reconstruir su cuerpo. Con nuevas energías gracias a sus nuevas y mejoradas partes, Marvin consigue fama al instante como superpolicía hasta que su instinto animal empieza a apoderarse de su cuerpo en los peores momentos. Y cuando se enamora de la encantadora y sexy Rianna (Haskell), ¡es magnetismo animal en su máxima expresión en la comedia más divertida y salvaje del año! No te pierdas a Rob Schneider en Big Daddy.

programme.title: Su Excelencia
programme.desc: Cantinflas trabaja en la embajada de Los Cocos repartiendo visados a todos los que desean visitar su país natal. En este momento el mundo está dividido en dos: los países rojos y los países verdes. Ambos bloques están igualados en fuerzas y la república de Los Cocos posee el voto definitivo. Por una serie de circunstancias, Cantinflas se convierte en el embajador.

programme.title: Novio Por Una Noche
programme.desc: A los diez años, Chuck (Dane Cook) rompió la regla básica del juego de la botella al negarse a besar a una chica gótica demente. Destrozada por su cruel rechazo y decidida a asegurarse que Chuck no encuentre nunca el amor verdadero, la vengativa chica le echa un maleficio al cobarde tramposo que lo persigue hasta su vida adulta. Veinte años después, Chuck es un dentista de éxito que no consigue mantener una relación estable. Un día, mientras asiste a la boda de una ex novia, Chuck se da cuenta de que todas las chicas con las que ha salido encontraron el amor verdadero con el siguiente hombre al que conocieron. Cuando se extiende el rumor de que Chuck es una especie de amuleto de la suerte para las mujeres que quieren casarse, todas las chicas a 150 kilómetros a la redonda empiezan a buscarlo para rollos de una noche Chuck no tarda en percatarse de lo vacío que puede ser el sexo sin amor verdadero. Al conocer a Cam (Jessica Alba), Chuck empieza a sospechar que ha encontrado a la mujer de sus sueños, ¿pero que será de su relación si Chuck y Cam duermen juntos? Ahora, para asegurarse de que Cam no acabe con el siguiente hombre al que conozca, Chuck por fin intentará romper la maldición que lo ha perseguido desde la niñez.

programme.title: Pintura de guerra
programme.desc: El teniente Billings debe entregar un tratado de paz al jefe Gray Cloud en nueve días o habrá guerra. Guiados por Taslik, hijo del jefe, enfrentan la sed y crecientes tensiones. Pero algo no encaja: Taslik lleva pintura de guerra. ¿Realmente los conduce a la paz o a una emboscada?

programme.title: La batalla de los rancheros
programme.desc: Antigua película del Oeste protagonizada por Brian Donlevy: La batalla de los rancheros - Las disputas por la propiedad de un hombre muerto se convierten en una sangrienta guerra en el campo.

programme.title: Las águilas negras de Santa Fe
programme.desc: Cuando los comanches se ponen en pie de guerra, los colonos se refugian en la Roca del Águila comandada por el Capitán Jackson.

programme.title: Texas Lady
programme.desc: Una mujer de cabeza fuerte del Este hereda un periódico en un pequeño pueblo de Texas donde los barones del ganado locales, que controlan la región, quieren quitársela de encima.

programme.title: Fuerte solitario
programme.desc: Cuando se produce una repentina oleada de asesinatos en la región del Big Bend de Texas, las sospechas recaen inmediatamente sobre un joven vagabundo que acaba de mudarse a la zona.

programme.title: Terra Nova
programme.desc: Con la abolición de la pena de muerte, las cárceles se están desbordando en todo el mundo, lo que representa un problema importante para las autoridades.

programme.title: Jinetes Espirituales
programme.desc: Cuando una adolescente rebelde es arrestada y condenada a un campamento de equinoterapia, establece una conexión con un enérgico pura sangre al que ayuda a entrenar con la orientación del dueño del rancho.

programme.title: Asesinatos en la Cabaña
programme.desc: Las vacaciones de una familia en una remota cabaña de Utah se convierten en pesadilla cuando dos intrusos enmascarados irrumpen en su hogar. Tras un estallido de violencia, sólo las hermanas Linnea y Tina sobreviven y deberán reunir fuerzas para contraatacar.

programme.title: Contención
programme.desc: ¿Qué ocurre cuando estalla una epidemia y no se sabe nada de ella? Puede ocurrir cualquier cosa. Poco a poco, los residentes se dan cuenta de que todos morirán a menos que se unan.

programme.title: Choque mortal
programme.desc: Una pareja en su luna de miel en Marruecos sobrevive a un accidente automovilístico mortal en medio del desierto.

programme.title: Fahrenheit 11/9
programme.desc: Fahrenheit 11/9 es una mirada polémica y cómica a los tiempos que corren en EE.UU. Michael Moore retrata las elecciones presidenciales de 2016 y estos dos primeros años del mandato de Donald Trump intentando responder las dos preguntas más importantes de la era Trump: “¿Cómo demonios hemos llegado hasta aquí?” y “¿Cómo demonios salimos?”.

programme.title: Prácticamente muerto
programme.desc: Clahan es un sacerdote protestante que dirige a un grupo de fanáticos de la supremacía blanca. Un día, durante un sermón, es asesinado por un extremista de izquierdas. Su inconsolable viuda, dispuesta a vengarse, busca la ayuda de dos fanáticos, que secuestran y torturan a un hombre al que creen culpable.

programme.title: Persecución
programme.desc: El detective Breslin se cruza con Calloway, un hacker despiadado desesperado por encontrar a su esposa que ha sido secuestrada por un cartel de la droga. Cuando Calloway escapa de la custodia policial, Breslin une fuerzas con una policía sensata para recuperar a su prisionera. Pero, sospecha que el padre de Calloway y jefe del crimen está involucrado de alguna manera.

programme.title: Exorcismo en Georgia
programme.desc: Poco después de trasladarse a su nueva casa en Georgia una pareja se entera de que su hija tiene misteriosas visiones de personas que nadie más que ella parece ver. Finalmente ellos también son testigos de extraños fenómenos que tienen lugar alrededor de la casa y que van aportando pistas de lo que podría ser un escalofriante misterio que se ha mantenido en secreto durante generaciones.

programme.title: El invierno de las anjanas
programme.desc: Adelaida pierde a su novio Eusebio en la Guerra de Cuba. Al no asumir la ausencia de Eusebio, la joven es ingresada en un sanatorio para enfermos mentales. En su reclusión, Adelaida rememora los recuerdos de su vida con Eusebio...

programme.title: Cuando todo esté en orden
programme.desc: Una película honesta y sentida sobre las relaciones entre padres e hijos y la devastación que suponen las drogas.

programme.title: Los días que vendrán
programme.desc: Vir (30) y Lluís (32) hace solo un año que salen juntos, cuando descubren que están “embarazados”. Durante 9 meses, seguiremos la aventura de esta joven pareja barcelonesa, el giro enorme que dará su vida, sus miedos, alegrías y las realidades que, durante su embarazo, crecen ante ellos.

programme.title: Amar
programme.desc: Una de las óperas primas más estimulantes y reveladoras del año. El talento de Esteban Crespo, nominado al Oscar por el cortometraje "Aquel no era yo" se confirma con esta película de amores tan intensos que se viven como si cada día fuera el último.

programme.title: La vergüenza
programme.desc: Pepe y Lucía no pueden con Manu. Lo han intentado todo, pero es inútil: el niño que adoptaron hace apenas un año les viene grande, no se hacen con él, y han decidido devolverlo. Sin embargo pronto se dan cuenta del precio que deberán pagar si quieren seguir adelante con su plan.

programme.title: Bus Driver
programme.desc: Un autobús escolar que se dirige a un retiro sufre un pinchazo y se detiene en el rancho más cercano en busca de ayuda. El conductor, cinco estudiantes problemáticos y su ridículo profesor de gimnasia como acompañante se encuentran, en cambio, con criminales dispuestos a todo para que sus operaciones de drogas no sean descubiertas. Los estudiantes y el profesor son presas fáciles para estos delincuentes, pero entre ellos y una muerte segura se interpone una fuerza más decidida y hábil de lo que jamás imaginaron: el conductor del autobús.

programme.title: Scarecrow
programme.desc: Seis estudiantes de secundaria se enfrentan a una entidad maligna mientras cumplen su castigo antes del festival del espantapájaros del pueblo.

programme.desc: David Terran, un brillante científico, ha perdido su credibilidad a causa de sus teorías apocalípticas. Las explosiones nucleares en Irán tendrán graves repercusiones y la comunidad científica tendrá que confiar en David.

programme.title: Top Gunner
programme.desc: Los graduados de una remota base de las Fuerzas Aéreas estadounidenses deben proteger un arma biológica de edición genética de los militares rusos, que están desesperados por hacerse con el agente vírico a cualquier precio.

programme.title: Asia connection
programme.desc: Dos expatriados estadounidenses, Jack y Sam deciden robar un banco. Sin saberlo se han llevado el dinero de un poderoso narcotraficante.

programme.title: Santos y soldados: Objetivo Berlín
programme.desc: El 15 de agosto de 1944, el equipo de combate del regimiento de paracaidistas llega al sur de Francia en una misión para apoyar a las tropas aliadas en su camino a Berlín. En su misión de guerra se encuentran con un grupo de franceses que necesitan ayuda, poniendo en peligro sus vidas y la misión.

programme.title: Power Rangers
programme.desc: Musculoso y espectacular reboot de la mítica serie de los 90' a medio camino entre 'Transformers' y el cine de superhéroes. 5 jóvenes estudiantes van a descubrir que La Tierra está al borde de la extinción por una amenaza alienígena.
